title: Revenue pressures harden after Company fiscal control
detail: Following expanded Company authority, land revenue demands remained severe despite growing signs of agrarian stress in Bengal districts.

title: Famine mortality spreads across Bengal
detail: Food scarcity escalated into mass death affecting cultivators, laborers, and urban poor populations across large parts of Bengal.

title: Long-term agrarian and demographic disruption
detail: The famine weakened rural production and social stability, while deepening criticism of extractive colonial governance in Bengal.
